name: severity-calibration
description: Labeled incidents for calibrating judge-severity. Each row is an incident description with the human-assigned severity branch (critical/high/medium/low) as expectedOutput. Run via the severity-calibration eval (exact scorer) to measure routing accuracy. Add rows from real triaged incidents to grow the corpus and tighten calibration over time.

rows.input: Production database is down. Every request returns a 500 for all users. Started 20 minutes ago and the error rate is still climbing.
Payment processing is failing for roughly 30% of checkout attempts across all regions; customers are being charged but not receiving confirmation.
A data bug permanently deleted some users' saved drafts after the latest update. The drafts are not recoverable from backups.
Login is broken for users on the latest iOS app version — they cannot access their accounts at all. Android and web are unaffected.
Search returns no results for any query containing an apostrophe or quote. A meaningful slice of searches are affected.
Push notifications are delayed by 10-15 minutes for users in the EU region. They still arrive, just late.
Profile avatars load slowly on slow networks and occasionally time out, falling back to a placeholder. Retried loads usually succeed.
Intermittent 502s on one non-critical analytics endpoint, about 1% of calls, and they self-recover on retry. No user-facing feature depends on it.
The 'recently viewed' list sometimes shows items in the wrong order until the page is refreshed. Cosmetic ordering only; data is correct.
There is a typo in the footer: the copyright year reads 2024 instead of 2025.
The 'Export CSV' button is misaligned by a few pixels on Firefox. It works correctly; it's just slightly off-center.
A tooltip on the settings page shows slightly outdated help text referencing an old menu name. No functional impact.
